scenarios.assumptions: A service reads stock, decides it is sufficient, then assigns a reduced quantity in a later statement. Two requests confirm purchases for one unit. How will you fix the race?

scenarios.theme: COMMIT was sent but the socket closed. Should the server-side operation be repeated?
